svg.title: Through the legs
svg.text: Through the legs: the butterfly's blind ring (Genesis)
Seen from above, to scale. The goalie faces down the page; his net is above him.
goal line (net behind)
blade (the stick's hot point)
his centre (position)
1. Front edge: only a sliver of his body
is tested before the ring begins; the
puck steps straight over it.
2. Blind ring (8-14 from the blade):
the stick doesn't play the puck, and the
body test is skipped. It slides through.
3. Out of the ring behind his centre:
the body test hits, and the bounce goes
out from his centre: back, into the net.
Under the rings: the game's own picture of the goalie in that butterfly (frame 480), drawn as on screen, his body rising up the page from his position.
body circle (reach 13 here; 12-15 by Agility)
within 8 of the blade: the stick plays a low puck
8-14 from the blade: nothing is tested at all
Only a puck at height 5 or less that isn't rising meets the stick at all; lifted pucks get the body test as usual.
Standing, his blade is in front of his middle, so the ring doesn't cover it. Dots: the puck once a frame at 22,700 (about 77 mph):
black untouched, white inside the blind ring, red the body hit. Recorded: three goals like this in the ANA-ATL 2-on-2 game.
